observations.title: A clearer brief — Fieldnote Notes
observations.text:
A clearer brief

Give a small project a clear starting point.

15 September 2026
Start with the outcome

Describe the change the project should make for the people using it.

Keep the brief close to the work so the team can revisit its purpose as decisions change.

Three useful questions
Who needs the result?
What should become easier?
How will the team recognize a useful outcome?

A short brief can still make the important choices explicit.

observations.text:
Make room in a check-in

Leave space for questions and decisions.

1 September 2026
Make the conversation useful

Ask what needs attention, then make time for the answer.

Name decisions clearly and give each next step an owner.
